name: ObsidianArc
description: A self-hosted AI platform with a Go server, multi-provider routing, usage tracking and an admin console, with chat and agentic work modes.

paragraphs: A self-hosted multi-user AI chat service and API gateway.
features: Accounts and Groups: Registration, authentication, and session management. User groups allow operators to assign model access lists and shared credit allowances.

Provider Aggregation and Model Routing: Compatible with Anthropic Messages API and OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenAI, DeepSeek, xAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, vLLM). Supports mapping multiple models per provider,…
